mapper.sql: id, org_id, activity_id, purpose, amount, incurred_on, category, handled_note, no_receipt_note, status, submitted_by, submitted_at, decided_by, decided_at, reject_reason, over_budget_note, void_reason, voided_at, corrects_expense_id, version, request_key, request_fingerprint, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense (org_id, activity_id, purpose, amount, incurred_on, category, handled_note, no_receipt_note, status, corrects_expense_id, request_key, request_fingerprint, created_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{activityId}, #{purpose}, #{amount}, #{incurredOn}, #{category}, #{handledNote}, #{noReceiptNote}, #{status}, #{correctsExpenseId}, #{requestKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM expense WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE expense SET purpose = #{purpose}, amount = #{amount}, incurred_on = #{incurredOn}, category = #{category}, handled_note = #{handledNote}, no_receipt_note = #{noReceiptNote}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') AND version = #{version}

UPDATE expense
status = #{toStatus}, version = version + 1,
submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
reject_reason = NULL,
reject_reason = #{reason},
over_budget_note = #{overBudgetNote},
WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE expense SET status = 'VOIDED', version = version + 1, void_reason = #{reason}, voided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), decided_by = #{actorAccountId}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED'
